name: ogbn-arxiv
description: A directed citation network of arXiv computer science papers, with papers as nodes, citation links as edges, and subject areas as node labels. The benchmark commonly uses the graph for paper subject-area classification.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
